runtimeMode.rule: The enterprise kernel is the horizontal-scale runtime substrate. Compatibility mode is preserved but is not evidence for the enterprise-scale claim.

implementation.tenantIsolationRls: PostgreSQL FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY plus explicit tenant_id on every key
implementation.subjectScopedConcurrency: subject current row lock + expected subject version; tenant revision is audit order only
implementation.incrementalIntegrity: 256 deterministic subject buckets + compact tenant state root
implementation.atomicBoundedCommitReceipt: bounded receipt committed with command ledger and audit event
implementation.orderedTenantAuditHead: late tenant-head FOR UPDATE after subject/bucket work
implementation.durableWorkClaims: durable work item row + SKIP LOCKED + monotonic fence
implementation.durableAsyncProviderWork: provider work queued in the same durable commit and returned as queued
implementation.sharedBlobAuthority: shared object-storage port with tenant-prefixed quarantine/clean namespaces
implementation.distributedRateAuthority: signed ingress rate decision verified by application runtime
implementation.boundedQueryProjections: keyset/cursor bounded current-subject projection, limit 10..200 with total truth
implementation.projectionDeltaReceipts: bounded dirty subjects and projection owners per tenant revision
implementation.revisionGapRecovery: contiguous apply, equal noop, gap/ahead refetch
implementation.statelessReplicas: enterprise profile rejects process-local business/work authority
implementation.externalObservability: external collector sink with bounded low-cardinality telemetry
